Karthik,

Really appreciate the heads-up and the clear ask. We want AstraMed to stay with Redwood, especially with the clinical launch looming. I ran an initial assessment with CS and revenue and here's a pragmatic, time-sensitive package we can offer pending executive approval:

1) One-time operational credit: $45,000 applied to the next invoice to make good on the February outage.
2) SLA top-up addendum: guaranteed 99.95% uptime for 12 months and a 2-hour P1 response SLA for incidents tagged during the launch window (we'll attach a draft addendum).
3) Short-term price protection: hold current per-token rate for the first 12 months of the renewed term (term remains 36 months).

We will need signoff for the credit amount and the SLA language to proceed. I'm attaching a concise concession summary and the proposed SLA addendum for legal to review. If you can confirm by COB 4 May, we can prepare a DocuSign amendment for execution by your 10 May target.

K
